stories.title: US envoys hold 'substantive' talks with Zelenskyy in first-ever Kyiv visit
stories.summary: Trump envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv for their first talks in the Ukrainian capital, renewed the push to end Russia's war. It's a notable shift after eight prior Moscow trips and a real test of the ceasefire push.

stories.title: Iranian tanker sinks in Gulf of Oman after US strike, CENTCOM says
stories.summary: A US strike sank an Iranian tanker in the Gulf of Oman, per CENTCOM, while US forces redirect commercial vessels amid an Iran blockade and strikes hit southern Lebanon. The sinking marks another escalation in the ongoing Iran war.

stories.title: Ackman reveals daughter got experimental mitochondrial eye transplant
stories.summary: Bill Ackman disclosed his blind 26-year-old daughter Lucy received an experimental mitochondrial transplant - mitochondria from her leg injected into both eyes under emergency FDA authorization after a February brain hemorrhage. It restored partial vision, a potential first for treating vision loss.

stories.title: Retro tech makes a comeback
stories.summary: TechCrunch surveys the retro gadgets, formats and old-school interfaces making a comeback as consumers mix nostalgia with modern utility. The trend points to renewed demand for simpler, tactile hardware.

stories.title: NASA expands Deep Space Network with giant new dish in California
stories.summary: NASA added a large new antenna to its Deep Space Network in California to boost communications capacity as more missions strain the aging network. The expansion keeps deep-space probes and human missions reliably in contact.

stories.title: Browns enter final Sunday before 2026 season opener
stories.summary: The Dawgs By Nature roundup covers the Browns' last weekend before the 2026 NFL season opens Wednesday, touching on defensive-line health, roster questions and expectations for first-year head coach Todd Monken. It sets up the outlook for a team in transition.

stories.title: Smith and Sayin help No. 1 Ohio State prepare for Texas with 56-3 rout of Ball State
stories.summary: Top-ranked Ohio State hammered Ball State 56-3 in the season opener, with receiver Jeremiah Smith and quarterback Julian Sayin leading the blowout at Ohio Stadium. The dominant win catapults OSU into next week's marquee matchup with Texas.

stories.title: Vettel returns to Red Bull and 'leaves surprise' for Verstappen at Monza
stories.summary: Sebastian Vettel made a return appearance with his old Red Bull team at Monza, leaving Max Verstappen a surprise tied to Michael Schumacher lore during the Italian GP weekend. The reunion drew a big crowd reaction at the Temple of Speed.

stories.title: Antonelli wins Italian Grand Prix at Monza from back of the grid
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli went from P20 - after a back-of-grid engine penalty - to victory in a sensational drive, passing Mercedes teammate George Russell to win on home soil and strengthen his title lead. It was a defining comeback win at the Temple of Speed.

stories.title: Antonelli: Ferrari links will follow me for life
stories.summary: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli told GPFans he expects constant Ferrari speculation throughout his career as an Italian driver, but insists he is happy at Mercedes, the team he joined as a 12-year-old. The comments keep the Scuderia rumor mill alive.
